text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Finally, the day of the Kikuka Sho has<n>arrived.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I won't let Bourbon pull away this<n>time.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'll follow behind her until the end...<n>And then...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I will catch up to her.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thanks. Off I go!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Memories of the Japanese Derby<n>unexpectedly
come to mind.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Bour-bon! Bour-bon!

Just listen to that crowd! The cheers<n>of those
excited to see the birth of a<n>champion echo
throughout the<n>grounds!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But now she has people cheering for<n>her too. Every
single voice shouting<n>her name should serve to
bolster her<n>confidence.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Go, Rice! You can beat Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The time you've all been waiting for<n>is here! Who
will seize glory at this<n>year's Kikuka Sho?

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon, the Auburn Rocket?<n>Or Rice
Shower, the Sable Stayer?<n>This will be a face-off for
the ages!
You can do it, Rice! Run your buns off!
Y-you can do it...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Not good enough! One more time, as<n>loud as you
can!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: YOU CAN DO IT, RICE!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hey look! It's Rice's trainer! Hiya!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: H-hello!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's Haru Urara and Zenno Rob Roy. If<n>I remember
right, Rob Roy is Rice<n>Shower's roommate.

Ehehe! We're here to support Rice,<n>duh! Isn't that
right, Rob Roy?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-yes! After all, she's been pushing<n>herself so
much recently...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
We thought she would appreciate it if<n>we came to
the racecourse to support<n>her.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: And that's what we're doing!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'm worried our voices can't actually<n>reach her, but
we're still going to<n>cheer her on with all our might!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Totally! One more time! Ready... now!

text_block_list.name: Urara and Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: You can do it, Rice! You can do it, Rice!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so, the Kikuka Sho starts amidst<n>a roar of
cheering voices.
